blockers.title: Queued observation dispatch bypasses actor/provider pin mismatch after a model switch
blockers.contract: README.md:19 and docs/BUILD-PLAN.md:26 require the acting model/provider to match the explicit observation pins.
blockers.mechanism: update_model marks _route_mismatch and advances _epoch, but leaves already queued _pending work. _work checks neither the route mismatch nor a pre-switch authorization token when starting each subsequent batch. The next loop captures the post-switch epoch, invokes the old pinned backend and can publish normally.
steps: Start a model-mode engine pinned to openai-codex/gpt-6-astra with explicit consent and matching actor. Use the actual ModelObserver and HermesCompletion, replacing only provider resolution with a synthetic client.
Hold the first synthetic client create call. Notify another completed turn so the source snapshot advances and _pending becomes true.
Call the actual engine update_model with provider=custom and model=synthetic-local-only. Confirm _route_mismatch is true, then release the already-running call.
Wait for the worker and read the real SQLite state.
blockers.expected: No new observer completion dispatch while the actor/provider no longer matches the pins; no publication by a newly started mismatched batch. An already-dispatched call need not be retroactively unsent.
blockers.impact: A route switch intended to stop same-route eligibility does not stop queued observation calls: additional source text reaches the old-route completion boundary and the result is accepted. This is an observed authorization/dispatch defect, not a claim that this review transmitted private data.
blockers.evidence_boundary: Real engine, ModelObserver, HermesCompletion and SQLite; provider resolver/client replaced by a synthetic test double and socket connect prohibited. Two completion dispatches were observed; no network or credentials were used.
blockers.required_change: Invalidate pending mismatched work and enforce current route/epoch authorization at each new dispatch and publication. Add a deterministic queued-work/model-switch regression, retaining the no-fallback rule and explicit treatment of calls already in flight.

blockers.title: Rejected replacement transcript leaves removed sources recallable and lets its old worker publish
blockers.contract: docs/BUILD-PLAN.md:28,57 require source removal to remove the plugin copy/derived observations and recall to expose only current sources. Unsupported attachments may keep the original actor request; that is not authorization to retain and republish removed source identities.
blockers.mechanism: normalize_sources or pairing failure returns before sync_sources and without invalidating _epoch or pending/in-flight work. The old source revision remains authoritative to the worker and read-only tools. A successful stale commit also clears the previous unsupported-input health error.
steps: Through the actual installed _notify_context_engine_turn_complete hook, start observation of six synthetic supported turns; hold the observer before it returns.
Deliver a completed replacement history that removes its first turn and appends a supported-host but plugin-unsupported structured-content user turn plus an assistant response.
Observe the explicit unsupported_or_sensitive_input failure, then release the old worker.
Read the real SQLite state; invoke om_recall for the removed source; close/reopen the engine and repeat recall. Check the real host request-selection helper separately.
blockers.expected: A rejected replacement must not authorize the previous worker to publish removed history or keep those IDs available as current source recall. Conservatively invalidate/quarantine/reconcile the plugin snapshot while leaving unsupported new content out of the store and retaining the canonical actor request.
blockers.impact: The removed synthetic source remains callable via om_recall across restart, and a new derived observation of it is durably published after the replacement hook. The actor request itself correctly falls back unchanged; the defect is stale persistence/recall, not malformed provider context.
blockers.evidence_boundary: Actual installed host hooks, actual engine/store, held offline ExtractiveObserver, disposable synthetic state. No host transcript was edited; the replacement was supplied as a synthetic completed-turn snapshot.
blockers.required_change: Make failure of authoritative snapshot normalization/eligibility invalidate stale work and prevent stale current-source/tool exposure; handle source removal conservatively without admitting attachments/secrets or using the human-only permanent forgetting tombstone as a model-controlled action. Regress both already-published and in-flight old data, plus restart and unchanged actor-request fallback.

nonblocking_limitations.topic: Publication deadline is not an end-to-end wall-clock bound
nonblocking_limitations.details: A timely result can wait in BEGIN IMMEDIATE and commit after job_timeout_seconds. In the final finite probe, the observer returned at 0.000071s, the write began at 0.001838s, and the separate SQLite lock was released at 1.256820s against a 1s configured deadline; eight observations committed with no error. This is retained as a nonblocking characterization, not mislabeled as a late observer return. A strict total publication/request-latency SLA is not certified.

The shipped adapter has timeout checks but arbitrary injected threads cannot be forcibly killed. Read-only installed Codex guard source uses progress-aware timeouts and a separate ceiling, so job_timeout_seconds is not certified as an absolute network termination or billing-token cap. No hosted timeout/transport experiment was run.

nonblocking_limitations.topic: Attribution versus truth and prompt injection
nonblocking_limitations.details: Exact quotes, fixed attribution, strict parser and untrusted historical rendering are real controls, not external verification, lossless meaning preservation, complete qualifier retention or perfect actor prompt-injection immunity. Lossy active selection and misleading-but-exact model substrings are explicitly accepted scope limits, not new blockers.

Plain visible text only, heuristic secret rejection, private local POSIX files rather than encryption or comprehensive PII/DLP protection. Static symlink/hardlink/inode replacement protections are tested; racing privileged/same-UID sabotage, network filesystems and Windows are not certified. SQLite creation crashes may require offline orphan inspection as already documented.

Only installed Hermes c8301ea6c9b797184df16a9c5dd462400b264ff4 and this managed macOS Python/SQLite environment are exercised. Session-only scope, best-effort post-turn hooks, no durable/emergency compression, no archive/cross-session system, no LongMemEval or general cost/accuracy claim. Large unsupported requests may still exceed actor context limits.

Installer/discovery/forget helpers were exercised by the deterministic suite in disposable homes. Package code and its allowlist were reviewed; final ZIP creation, extraction and disposable installed-ZIP execution are the parent lane and are not certified by this verdict. No live installation, activation, profile configuration, gateway or credentials were accessed/changed.

Reviewed request/prefix equality checks and deep-copy construction, validator snapshot-before-check regressions, plus real host request/post-turn clone boundaries. No product write-through to canonical history was observed in the suite. No extra source-only race was promoted to an exploit: hypothetical mutation of caller-owned request objects or data already snapshotted in an in-flight call is not proven live-host reachability.

positive_findings: Request-only shaping and no-op durable compression respect the approved v0.1 separation.
Strict exact-quote source binding, immutable role-derived attribution, unknown-field rejection and deterministic reflection are exercised.
Read-only om_* tools reject alternate profile/session/path arguments; separate namespaces and disabled tombstones hold under tested restart/process races.
Source and observation publication CAS repair is present and independently passes its real-SQLite regression.
SQLite raw-descriptor lock-loss repair is present; all four independent-process lock oracles pass.
Real installed user-directory loader, ABC and post-turn/request-selection hooks pass with disposable state.

Source-removal, secure-delete, process crash recovery, page-limit rollback, symlink/hardlink/inode replacement and create-only install cases pass in the existing suite, subject to OM-R2 at the engine ingestion boundary.

"""Bounded independent read-only candidate probes; synthetic scratch only."""
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path('/Users/mini/workspace/hermes-observational-memory')
HOST = Path('/Users/mini/.hermes/hermes-agent')
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
os.environ['HERMES_DISABLE_LAZY_INSTALLS'] = '1'
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tools'))
from runtime import bootstrap_hermes
_, scratch = bootstrap_hermes(str(HOST))
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import logging
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch
from observational.engine import EngineConfig, ObservationalEngine, normalize_sources
from observational.observer import ExtractiveObserver
from observational.contracts import canonical_json, reflect, validate_observations


def history(turns=6):
    rows = []
    for i in range(turns):
        rows.extend([{'role': 'user', 'content': 'SYNTHETIC_OLD_SOURCE_%s. Plan not performed. ' % i + 'Background only. ' * 140, 'message_uid': 'u%s' % i}, {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'Not externally verified.', 'message_uid': 'a%s' % i}])
    return rows


def config(**kw):
    return EngineConfig(observe_min_chars=1, max_batch_chars=200000, observation_budget_chars=8000, **kw)


def route_queue(home):
    entered, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    calls = []
    engine = ObservationalEngine(config=config(observer_mode='model', allow_model_calls=True, provider='openai-codex', model='gpt-6-astra'))
    engine.on_session_start('route-queue', hermes_home=home, model='gpt-6-astra', provider='openai-codex')
    def create(**kw):
        payload = json.loads(kw['messages'][1]['content'])
        calls.append({'route_mismatch_at_dispatch': engine._route_mismatch, 'actor_provider_at_dispatch': engine._actor_provider, 'requested_model': kw['model'], 'source_count': len(payload['sources'])})
        if len(calls) == 1:
            entered.set()
            if not release.wait(10):
                raise RuntimeError('probe release timed out')
        s = payload['sources'][0]
        text = canonical_json({'observations': [{'source_id': s['source_id'], 'quote': s['text'][:50], 'kind': 'other', 'priority': 1}]})
        return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content=text, tool_calls=None))], usage=None)
    client = SimpleNamespace(chat=SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=create)), close=lambda: None)
    try:
        engine.update_model('gpt-6-astra', 200000, provider='openai-codex')
        with patch('agent.auxiliary_client.resolve_provider_client', return_value=(client, 'gpt-6-astra')) as resolver:
            engine.on_turn_complete(history(6))
            assert entered.wait(10), 'first observer never entered'
            engine.on_turn_complete(history(7))  # A real newer snapshot queues another batch.
            assert engine._pending
            engine.update_model('synthetic-local-only', 200000, provider='custom')
            assert engine._route_mismatch
            release.set()
            assert engine.wait_until_idle(15)
            state = engine.store.read()
            result = {'dispatches': calls, 'resolver_calls': resolver.call_count, 'observations_after_mismatch': len(state['observations']), 'covered_after_mismatch': len(state['covered_ids']), 'last_error': engine.get_status()['last_error'], 'discarded': engine.get_status()['discarded_runs'], 'real_network_calls': 0}
            assert len(calls) == 2 and calls[1]['route_mismatch_at_dispatch'] and state['observations']
            return result
    finally:
        release.set()
        engine.wait_until_idle(15)
        engine.on_session_end('route-queue', [])


def unsupported_replacement(home):
    from agent.conversation_loop import _notify_context_engine_turn_complete, _apply_context_engine_selection
    entered, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    class Held:
        def observe(self, sources, *, observed_at):
            entered.set()
            if not release.wait(10):
                raise RuntimeError('probe release timed out')
            return ExtractiveObserver().observe(sources, observed_at=observed_at)
    engine = ObservationalEngine(config=config(), observer=Held())
    engine.on_session_start('unsupported-replacement', hermes_home=home, model='synthetic')
    agent = SimpleNamespace(context_compressor=engine, session_id='unsupported-replacement')
    logger = logging.getLogger('independent-synthetic-probe')
    original = history()
    changed = copy.deepcopy(original[2:]) + [{'role': 'user', 'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'New structured attachment turn.'}]}, {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'Attachment acknowledged.'}]
    old_id = normalize_sources(original)[0]['id']
    try:
        _notify_context_engine_turn_complete(agent, original, logger=logger, interrupted=False, failed=False)
        assert entered.wait(10)
        before = engine.store.read()
        _notify_context_engine_turn_complete(agent, changed, logger=logger, interrupted=False, failed=False)
        failed_revision = engine.store.read()['revision']
        invalid_error = engine.get_status()['last_error']
        release.set()
        assert engine.wait_until_idle(15)
        state = engine.store.read()
        recall = json.loads(engine.handle_tool_call('om_recall', {'source_id': old_id}))
        request = changed + [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Read current history only.'}]
        selected = _apply_context_engine_selection(agent, request, changed, request[-1], logger=logger)
        result = {'revision_before_replacement': before['revision'], 'revision_after_rejected_replacement': failed_revision, 'revision_after_old_worker': state['revision'], 'error_after_replacement': invalid_error, 'error_after_worker': engine.get_status()['last_error'], 'current_history_contains_removed_marker': 'SYNTHETIC_OLD_SOURCE_0' in canonical_json(changed), 'removed_source_recallable': 'SYNTHETIC_OLD_SOURCE_0' in recall.get('text', ''), 'old_observation_published': any(old_id in o['source_ids'] for o in state['observations']), 'actor_request_retained': selected == request}
        assert result['removed_source_recallable'] and result['old_observation_published'] and result['actor_request_retained']
    finally:
        release.set()
        engine.wait_until_idle(15)
        engine.on_session_end('unsupported-replacement', [])
    reopened = ObservationalEngine(config=config())
    reopened.on_session_start('unsupported-replacement', hermes_home=home, model='synthetic')
    try:
        result['removed_source_recallable_after_restart'] = 'SYNTHETIC_OLD_SOURCE_0' in json.loads(reopened.handle_tool_call('om_recall', {'source_id': old_id})).get('text', '')
        assert result['removed_source_recallable_after_restart']
        return result
    finally:
        reopened.on_session_end('unsupported-replacement', [])


def lock_deadline(home):
    entered, release, begin = threading.Event(), threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    measurements = {}
    class Held:
        def observe(self, sources, *, observed_at):
            entered.set()
            if not release.wait(10):
                raise RuntimeError('probe release timed out')
            measurements['observer_return'] = time.monotonic()
            return ExtractiveObserver().observe(sources, observed_at=observed_at)
    engine = ObservationalEngine(config=config(job_timeout_seconds=1.0), observer=Held())
    engine.on_session_start('deadline', hermes_home=home, model='synthetic')
    other = sqlite3.connect(engine.store.path.as_uri() + '?mode=rw', uri=True, isolation_level=None)
    try:
        engine.on_turn_complete(history())
        assert entered.wait(10)
        start = engine._started_at
        other.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
        def trace(sql):
            if sql == 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE':
                measurements['begin'] = time.monotonic()
                begin.set()
        engine.store._conn.set_trace_callback(trace)
        release.set()
        assert begin.wait(10)
        assert measurements['begin'] < start + 1.0, 'setup did not reach DB wait before deadline'
        time.sleep(max(0, start + 1.25 - time.monotonic()))
        measurements['unlock'] = time.monotonic()
        other.execute('ROLLBACK')
        assert engine.wait_until_idle(15)
        state = engine.store.read()
        result = {'deadline_seconds': 1.0, 'observer_return_seconds': measurements['observer_return'] - start, 'begin_attempt_seconds': measurements['begin'] - start, 'unlock_seconds': measurements['unlock'] - start, 'observations_after_deadline': len(state['observations']), 'last_error': engine.get_status()['last_error'], 'interpretation': 'Timely observer result can commit after SQL lock waiting exceeds configured job timeout; no late observer return simulated.'}
        assert state['observations'] and measurements['unlock'] > start + 1.0
        return result
    finally:
        release.set()
        if other.in_transaction:
            other.execute('ROLLBACK')
        other.close()
        engine.wait_until_idle(15)
        engine.on_session_end('deadline', [])


def receipts():
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/evidence/review-candidate-01.json').read_text())
    module = ast.parse((ROOT / 'tools/replay.py').read_text())
    fixture_def = next(n for n in module.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'fixture')
    env = {}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fixture_def], type_ignores=[]), '<reviewed-replay-fixture-only>', 'exec'), env)
    sources = normalize_sources(env['fixture']())
    output = {}
    for mode in ('model', 'offline'):
        path = ROOT / ('docs/evidence/%s-replay-02.json' % mode)
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        actual_hash = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert actual_hash == manifest['%s_replay_sha256' % mode]
        assert data['pass'] and data['source_count'] == len(sources)
        assert data['observation_count'] == len(data['observations'])
        assert data['active_observation_count'] == len(data['active_ids'])
        assert data['hermes_commit'] == 'c8301ea6c9b797184df16a9c5dd462400b264ff4'
        assert len(data['source_sha256']) == 6
        assert all(hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == h == manifest['sha256'][name] for name, h in data['source_sha256'].items())
        validate_observations(data['observations'], sources[:data['covered_source_count']])
        assert reflect(data['observations'], 8000) == data['active_ids']
        assert ObservationalEngine()._render({'observations': data['observations'], 'active_ids': data['active_ids'], 'covered_ids': [s['id'] for s in sources[:data['covered_source_count']]]}) == data['active_memory_text']
        for key in ('exact_source_recall', 'original_transcript_unchanged', 'repeated_selection_equal', 'restart_equal', 'forgotten_tombstone'):
            assert data[key] is True
        if mode == 'model':
            assert data['expected_answers'] == data['baseline_answers'] == data['observed_answers']
            for key in ('calls', 'prompt_tokens', 'completion_tokens', 'total_tokens'):
                assert data['whole_probe_usage'][key] == data['observer_usage'][key] + data['actor_usage'][key]
        output[mode] = {'sha256': actual_hash, 'source_hashes_matched': True, 'source_quotes_validated': len(data['observations']), 'rendering_and_reflection_match': True, 'mode': data['mode'], 'pass_field': data['pass'], 'model_rerun': False}
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'docs/test-run-02.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == manifest['test_log_sha256']
    return output


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='om-independent-review-01-6f9a-', dir=scratch) as tmp:
    os.environ['HERMES_HOME'] = tmp
    os.environ['HERMES_DISABLE_MCP'] = '1'
    os.environ['TMPDIR'] = tmp
    tempfile.tempdir = tmp
    # Safety backstop: no actual socket connect, including provider/network.
    with patch('socket.socket.connect', side_effect=AssertionError('network forbidden in independent review')), patch('socket.socket.connect_ex', side_effect=AssertionError('network forbidden in independent review')):
        report = {'receipt_validation': receipts(), 'route_queue': route_queue(tmp), 'unsupported_replacement': unsupported_replacement(tmp), 'lock_deadline_characterization': lock_deadline(tmp), 'runtime': {'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'sqlite': sqlite3.sqlite_version}}
    owned = Path(tmp)
report['owned_synthetic_state_removed'] = not owned.exists()
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
